snippet.title: [PC-98] Night Slave 1cc (Normal)
snippet.description:
Basically Assault Suits Valken for the PC-98. Played on NP21w.

Game crashed on Stage 7 ( forcing me to replay the stage which is why stage 8 has a different score total at the start) and on the final boss of stage 9.  Other than that, you can cruise for most of the game if you do well on the first two stages/ stage 5. 

Enjoy the run!
